_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. 'pairs' are before/after pairs shown under the satellite comparison. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

apmc-kalyan.alt: Precast prestressed concrete cross arm on top of a station pier at APMC Kalyan, with piers SP.09 and CSP.10 in front and traffic on the road below, at night
apmc-kalyan.caption: Newly installed cross arm above piers SP.09 and CSP.10, one of two installed at the station

apmc-kalyan.alt: Second precast prestressed concrete cross arm on the station pier beside pier SP.02 at APMC Kalyan, at night
apmc-kalyan.caption: The second newly installed cross arm, beside pier SP.02

amandoot.alt: Station piers SP01 and SP02 for Amandoot station with their wide pier caps, and round pier P648 in front, on cleared muddy ground under a cloudy sky
amandoot.caption: Station piers SP01 and SP02, with the temporary steel supports now removed

amandoot.alt: A row of Line 12 station piers on cleared ground beside the green arched roof of Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1's Amandoot station
amandoot.caption: The station area beside Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1's Amandoot station

amandoot.alt: Two tall reinforcement cages for new piers on a muddy site, with workers below and the Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1 viaduct behind
amandoot.caption: Reinforcement cages for the first pair of piers on the left and right of the line

amandoot.alt: A finished pier with its pier cap beside a road, more piers beyond, and the Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1 viaduct on the right with traffic below
amandoot.caption: Finished piers beside the road, with the Line 1 viaduct on the right

amandoot.alt: An elevated viaduct section with its deck and parapets complete, standing on a row of piers among trees
amandoot.caption: The reversal area beyond Amandoot, which the photographer reports is complete

amandoot.alt: Station piers for Amandoot station held up by rusty steel trestles and blue formwork, with pier SP01 in the centre
amandoot.caption: Station piers SP01 and SP02 on temporary steel supports during pier cap casting

amandoot.alt: The Amandoot station piers on steel trestles, seen from a wet paved footpath with tall residential towers behind
amandoot.caption: The same station piers from the footpath, during the monsoon

amandoot.alt: Blue steel formwork around a pier beside the Line 1 Amandoot station building, with a red mobile crane on the right
amandoot.caption: Formwork for a pier beside the Line 1 station building
